description: Product repos that must ship one checked-in verification skill at .claude/skills/verify-<app>/SKILL.md (standing rule Per-repo verification harness, fleet-ops#524). The canary joins intake-repos.json repos[] + deferred[] against this skip list. Enrolled products fail-loud when the harness is missing or incomplete; deferred products auto-file (observe-to-open). skip[] is the non-product set: control plane, private sinks, utilities, mirrors, archived, forbidden second dispatcher.
